clips.title: The story
paras: At Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Frahun Shadewhisper trains night elf rogues. He teaches new scouts and rogues stealth, agility, and covert strikes. Erion Shadewhisper, another rogue trainer in Darnassus, shares his family name.

At Aldrassil in Teldrassil, Frahun Shadewhisper teaches new rogues concealment and bladecraft. Night elf society honors priests, sentinels, and druids, yet scouts and infiltrators also help safeguard the World Tree's boughs. Recruits bring Frahun an encrypted sigil. He weighs their potential and guides their first steps in the craft.
